solution: The range test rejects impossible numbers but accepts a mistyped value such as12 instead of 21. Compare the entered value with the original form or use independently repeated entry and resolve differences. Rule conformity and faithful transcription are different checks.

marking_points.criterion: Range test checks permitted values, not intended source value.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Concrete answer reasoned and checked against full syllabus guidance and available source MS.
